635:t_002:5.en:
$$連邦兵$$
「But under these conditions, even a retreat...!」

635:t_002:6.en:
$$アンドレイ$$
「Brigadier General $$マネキン$$! I'll secure an escape route!」

635:t_002:8.en:
$$アンドレイ$$
「You must rebuild the Federation forces after this, General! Please survive so you can do that!」

635:t_002:9.en:
$$アンドレイ$$

635:t_002:11.en:
$$アンドレイ$$

635:t_004:1.en:
$$ピーリス$$

635:t_004:2.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Protecting the Colonel is my job! Protecting Earth is our job!」

635:t_004:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$カティ$$...! Leave the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ core to us, and gather your remaining forces!」

635:t_004:4.en:
$$カティ$$
「Understood! I'm counting on you, $$クジョウ$$!」

635:t_004:5.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「I'm heading out, Colonel!」

635:t_004:6.en:
$$カティ$$
「How many times must I tell you I'm a Brigadier General...!」

635:t_004:10.en:
$$アンドレイ$$
「I'm counting on you to protect Earth... and humanity, $c!」

635:t_006:1.en:
$$トロワ$$
「And that thing waiting behind them is...」

635:t_007:0.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「It's less an asteroid than something the size of a moon!」

635:t_007:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「So this battle won't end unless we do something about that thing!?」

635:t_007:3.en:
$$シンジ$$
「But with this many to face...!」

635:t_007:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「Don't lose heart, $$シンジ$$! We'll handle them ourselves until $$刹那$$ arrives!」

635:t_007:5.en:
$$レド$$
「$$チェインバー#pilot$$. Analyze the balance of forces.」

635:t_007:6.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Based on the disparity in forces and the pilots' exhaustion, I estimate our combat limit at five minutes.」

635:t_007:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「To take on this huge swarm in just five minutes...」

635:t_007:8.en:
$n
「Our job isn't to destroy the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$! It's to hold the line until $$刹那$$ arrives!」

635:t_007:9.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「There are $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ in the surrounding sectors too...! We'll stop the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ in this area within five minutes!」

635:t_007:12.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「As long as I live, you mustn't die either.」

635:t_007:14.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Remember that too, $$ゼクス$$. Our battle doesn't end here.」

635:t_007:15.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Just what I'd expect from that young man's trusted friend... It seems he isn't the only one I must surpass.」

635:t_007:16.en:
$$グラハム$$
「On this battlefield... I too will risk my life! But I dare to declare...!」

635:t_007:17.en:
$$グラハム$$
「That I will come home alive!」

635:t_007:18.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The same goes for us!」

635:t_007:19.en:
$$シン$$
「We finally drove out the Empire! Like hell I'm dying when things are just getting started!」

635:t_007:20.en:
$$ロックオン$$
(We'll do this, $$刹那$$...! So get here quickly!)

635:t_007:21.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
(You're the one who will decide the outcome of this battle... humanity's tomorrow!)

635:t_007:22.en:
$$ラッセ$$
(We're counting on you to look after $$刹那$$, $$フェルト$$!)

635:t_007:23.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
(We'll manage the bridge ourselves!)

635:t_007:24.en:
$$トライア$$
「Everyone, be careful. Somehow I have a feeling this battle... won't end with just the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$.」

635:t_007:25.en:
$$クロウ$$
「After a hellish battle like this, nothing that happens next will surprise me.」

635:t_007:27.en:
$$シモン$$
(I know... If we have to, I'll try breaking through with my drill.)

635:t_007:28.en:
$$シモン$$
(I'm sorry, $$刹那$$, but if there's no other way, I'll drill right through that thing...!)

635:t_007:29.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, begin attacking! Stop the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$ in front of us within these five minutes!」

635:t_008:1.en:

635:t_009:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$

635:t_009:5.en:
$$カレン$$

635:t_009:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「In fact, they appear to be even stronger!」

635:t_009:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$

635:t_009:8.en:
$$トライア$$
「Be careful! It looks like something troublesome is being sent in!」
